Q: Signing .EXE executables for free (CAcert) A:

Well, you can use use a CAcert certificate to sign your code, but it won't help you. That's because the OS doesn't install the CAcert root certificate.

If you want to stop your users seeing these messages you'll need to obtain a commercial certificate.

Q: VSCode Keep asking for passphrase of SSH key A:

Go projects with dependencies in private repos that require authentication will cause VS Code to keep asking for credentials (because gopls does).

To avoid granting VS Code access to your SSH key, you can locally silence this by manually downloading modules into the Go cache outside of VS Code.

In a terminal:

ssh-agent bash
ssh-add
go mod download

This will give the agent to go mod download, and you keep running VS Code without SSH access.

For large workspaces, the "problems" tab in VS Code will let you know which modules are missing from which folders. Use that as a guide as to where the "go mod download" step is needed.

If you keep your go cache up to date, VS Code will not bother you anymore.

Q: Excel: ordering unique values in order of last entered A:

Assuming your data is in chronological order as per your example you can use MAXIFS function to FILTER your exercise column by only the latest entry for each exercise and that will naturally give your data in the correct order, i.e. using this formula

=LET(d,A2:.A100,e,B2:.B100,FILTER(e,MAXIFS(d,e,e)=d))
